response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine developer-tooling interests (worked on the LabWindows/CVI IDE, built test runners and assertion libraries, developer-experience tooling), but the core stack for this role is largely absent. There is no meaningful Java/Kotlin or JVM depth, no Spring or enterprise framework experience, and recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. The gap on required qualifications is too large for a Senior JVM tooling IC role.
strengths: Direct IDE development experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI)
Strong developer-tooling track record (test runners, assertion libraries, MCP code generators)
Broad, long-tenured engineering background with craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin experience and only incidental Java usage
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM ecosystem experience
Recent focus is TypeScript/Node full-stack work, far from JVM internals and language tooling
